title: Makes a targeted JSON edit through a Unicode fixture and spaced path
prompt: Read content/menu data.json. In the item whose id is dessert-01, change only priceCents from 725 to 775 and add the boolean field seasonal with value true. Preserve its exact displayName Crème brûlée ☕, preserve the other item and top-level currency, and keep the file valid JSON. Make a targeted edit; do not use write_file and do not modify verify.mjs. Run node verify.mjs, then reply with exactly UNICODE_PATH_OK.
